name: Nevermined
description: Payment rails for agents: buy paid AI services over x402 and MPP from one card-funded, spend-capped budget, or charge for your own agent or MCP server with payment plans and metering.

skills.name: Pay with x402
skills.description: Pays x402 and MPP services through the Nevermined Router from one budget, without each service integrating Nevermined.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Enrolls a card and creates a delegation, a spend mandate with an amount, an expiry and a number of purchases.

skills.name: Search AI Service Catalog
skills.description: Discovers paid AI services in the Nevermined Catalog via the hosted Catalog MCP, keyless for discovery.

skills.name: Charge for Your Agent
skills.description: Puts an x402 paywall on an agent, API or MCP server with fiat or crypto payment plans and per-request credit metering.
